title: Coefficient Problems and Sharp Determinant Estimates for the Class $\mathcal{P}^{*}$
summary: We study coefficient problems for the class $\mathcal{P}^{*}$ of normalized analytic functions $f$ in the unit disk satisfying the subordination condition \[ f'(z) \prec e^z(1+\sin z), \qquad z\in\mathbb{D}. \] For functions in this class, we determine sharp bounds for the logarithmic coefficients $γ_n$ for $n=1,2,3,4$ and for the inverse logarithmic coefficients $Γ_n$ for $n=1,2,3$. In particular, we prove \[ |γ_n| \le \frac{1}{n+1} \quad (n=1,2,3,4), \qquad |Γ_1|,|Γ_2| \le \frac12,\quad |Γ_3|\le \frac{35}{48}, \] with equality cases explicitly identified.
